e7_s4_rejected.label: Leiomyoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Leiomyomas are typically smaller and less likely to cause significant symptoms or ulceration.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Lipoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Lipomas are benign tumors composed of fat tissue, but the presence of ulcerated areas and contrast enhancement on CT makes this diagnosis less likely.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: The CT findings and biopsy results do not support a diagnosis of gastric adenocarcinoma, as there is no evidence of mucosal invasion or adenocarcinoma on biopsy.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Leiomyosarcomas are malignant tumors that can present with similar symptoms, but the lack of significant bleeding, anemia, or other signs of malignancy makes this diagnosis less likely.
